metric_definitions.reference_scattering_nrmse: RMS discrepancy between estimate and hidden standard-reference full-FFT shell scattering sampled at every468 measured q, divided by max(reference scattering)-min(reference scattering); no rescaling, spatial alignment or molecular-truth claim. Ground truth takes precedence if present; otherwise baseline_reference supplies reconstruction. Independent5 source starts agree at floating-point roundoff;1e-6 is a documented nonzero conservative numerical tolerance.
metric_definitions.chi2: Mean squared residual divided by supplied experimental sigma squared over all468 measured q; fixed normalization I/I_GNOM(0); no amplitude or offset fitting. Full Fourier shell average, cubic shell interpolation as in source.
metric_definitions.negative_mass_fraction: absolute negative mass / positive mass, preserving final Fourier-projection tail
metric_definitions.outside_mass_fraction: Positive mass beyond radius Dmax40A from acquisition-independent integer center / positive mass; soft support, not a hard molecular boundary.
metric_definitions.disconnected_fraction: 1 - largest connected positive mass fraction within Gaussian sigma1.5vox/core20percent support
metric_definitions.porod_tail_relative_rms: RMS of (computed shell intensity/declared Porod extrapolation - 1) for all shells above measured qmax
metric_definitions.rg_relative_error: abs(first-shell scattering Rg - weighted Guinier Rg from actual measurements q<=0.08/A)/measurement Rg

baseline.method: Qualified original Hermitian-corrected DENSS, five independent seeds41-45, final Fourier projection; no spatial truth

scientific_nonuniqueness: No voxel-reference NCC/NRMSE or hidden seed criterion. Rotation/handedness/translation do not identify molecular shape; shape differences are reported only.
